title: Planetary Geology
description: Every rocky planet sorts itself the same way: iron sinks to a core, rock floats above as mantle and crust. Comparing their cores tells how planets form.

puzzle.goal: A planet of mass M and radius R, of even density, squeezes its centre. Write the pressure P there, with gravity's constant G.
puzzle.name: Central pressure of a uniform planet
puzzle.ask: Find P in GPa (u = @{u}) for the Earth: M = @{M} kg, R = @{R} m, G = 6.674e-11.
puzzle.method: Integrate dP/dr = −ρg(r) from the surface in, with g(r) = (4/3)πGρr.
